name: pfair-tooling
description: Work with Proforce Airsystems' in-house engineering tooling (PF-AIR) from Claude: inventory and stock, BOM checks and reservations, projects and their parts lists, and Engineering Change Requests. Bulk, irreversible and delete actions always go through a preview and a single-use confirmation code.

service_password.description: Password for the service account above.
